        return Integer.reverse(n) >>> (32 - k);
    }

        return modularExponentiation(a, MOD - 2);
    }

            return 1;

        long halfPower = modularExponentiation(a, p / 2);
        long result = (halfPower * halfPower) % MOD;
        if (p % 2 == 1) {
            result = (result * a) % MOD;

        return result;
